title: More than 15,000 join One Piece Run 2026 at SM Mall of Asia
summary: More than 15,000 runners took part in the One Piece Run 2026 on Saturday at the SM Mall of Asia Complex, combining a road race with a celebration of the popular Japanese anime and manga franchise.
